title: Design Google Drive File Storage
description: Model files, folders, permissions, sharing, and sync.

data.text: Design a file storage system like Google Drive. Users create files and folders, organize them hierarchically, share with permissions, and sync across devices.

data.title: File, Folder, and Permission
Why ContentHash?
data.text: ContentHash (SHA-256) lets Drive deduplicate files. If two users upload the same file, store it once. The hash also enables integrity verification and delta sync.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: FileItem represents both files and folders (ParentId is null for root)
ContentHash enables deduplication and integrity checks
Hierarchical paths are derived from ParentId chain
data.takeaway: Drive is a tree with an ACL. Files are nodes. Permissions are edges. Sync is a diff algorithm on top of ContentHash.
